## My courses

**POLI 320: Issues in Canadian Democracy.** I designed and taught this
third-year undergraduate course at McGill University. Each week focused on a
different challenge to Canadian democracy and covered the nature of the
problem, its causes, and the available solutions. Topics included political
participation, representation, regional grievances, the concentration of
power, the changing media environment, political marketing, polarization,
trust in institutions, and disinformation.
[Syllabus](POLI320_W23.pdf).

## Teaching assistantships

**POLI 618: Quantitative Analysis.** Graduate seminar on quantitative methods
at McGill University (Prof. Aaron Erlich). Led a one-hour lab each week.

**Computing and Math Summer Camp.** Intensive R workshop for graduate
students.

**CEP 1000: Fondements politiques de la communication politique.** Introductory
political communication course at Université de Montréal (Prof. Frédérick
Bastien).
